name: loki-logs
description: Grafana Loki integration — query logs with LogQL, run instant and range queries, and inspect label names and values via the Loki HTTP API. Works with a plain Loki server or a token/basic-auth setup, and supports multi-tenant Loki via X-Scope-OrgID.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Grafana Loki log aggregation — LogQL queries, labels, and label values

fields.label: Server URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of the Loki server (the /loki/api/v1 paths are appended automatically).

fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.helpText: Optional bearer token for proxied/authenticated setups such as Grafana Cloud.

fields.label: Basic Auth Username
fields.helpText: Optional username for HTTP basic auth (used only when no bearer token is set).

fields.label: Basic Auth Password
fields.helpText: Optional password for HTTP basic auth.

tools.name: loki.query
tools.description: Run an instant LogQL query and return matching log streams or metric values at a single point in time.

time.description: Optional evaluation timestamp (RFC3339 or Unix nanoseconds); defaults to now

tools.name: loki.query_range
tools.description: Run a LogQL query over a time range and return matching log streams or metric series.

query.description: LogQL expression to evaluate over the range

step.description: Query resolution step for metric queries, e.g. 15s, 1m, 1h

direction.description: Sort order of returned entries (default backward)

tools.name: loki.list_labels
tools.description: List all label names present within an optional time range.

start.description: Optional range start (RFC3339 or Unix nanoseconds)

end.description: Optional range end (RFC3339 or Unix nanoseconds)

tools.name: loki.label_values
tools.description: List all values for a given label name within an optional time range.

label.description: Label name, e.g. app, namespace, or job

start.description: Optional range start (RFC3339 or Unix nanoseconds)

end.description: Optional range end (RFC3339 or Unix nanoseconds)
